name: additional track deformation
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 由基础等外部几何变化传递形成的轨道变形。
usage_overview: 地表变形传递到轨道后产生的额外几何变化，可作为动力模型的激励输入，用于评估地表变形影响下的车致振动。

complete_examples.text: Several related research on the mapping relationship between initial bridge deformation and additional track deformation have also been analyzed by numerical method (Gou et al. 2018, 2019; Jiang et al. 2019; Nie et al. 2021).

The iterative method is discussed and applied to calculate the additional track deformation in the literature (Li, Xu, and Wang 2022b), but the method is lack of versatility: the conver-gence of iterative method is low when deals with the model with high degrees of freedom (DOFs).
The ground deformation-induced additional track deformation and interlayer void were calculated by model 2, and were regarded as the external geometric excitation of the dynamic interaction model 1.

The effects of long-wavelength additional track deformation and the interlayer dynamic contact on the vehicle-induced vibrations were analyzed based on the integration of the conventional track irregularity excitation.
